findings.summary: Luna returned no current products despite the official homepage exposing a substantial Lunch/Dinner/Brunch catalog. Terra independently found current products missing from the frozen baseline, including Shrimp Martini, Spicy Rigatoni, Pork Chop Martini, Classic Benedict, and seven daily specials.
Luna did not enumerate the linked Lunch, Dinner, and Brunch PDF surfaces. The verifier could identify them from the official homepage but could not reopen them, leaving menu scope incomplete.

Frozen rows label many arrays as official ingredients, while the current restaurant-issued surface provides only dish descriptions. It supports narrow named-ingredient positives, not complete allergen arrays, allergen negatives, or may-contain claims.

The frozen baseline contains duplicate/misspelled records and non-product fragments or descriptions, including both Bolognaise/Bolognese, both Chicken Paillard/Paillarp, two pancake rows, sauce/ingredient text, “per person,” “half-priced,” and “Slide 6 of.”
No restaurant-issued cross-contact or shared-equipment statement was found. The homepage’s raw-or-undercooked-food warning is not cross-contact evidence.

verifier.summary: Identity and the scout homepage surface are verified. Luna missed three linked menu-PDF surfaces and a substantial current catalog. The restaurant-issued HTML provides partial recipe-style descriptions only; therefore frozen complete allergen arrays/source authority, any negative claims, and all cross-contact conclusions are not verified. The result requires Sol review.
